In meteorology, the term "May 3" is synonymous with the F5 tornado.

de: Washington, D.C. is incorporated as a city after Congress abolishes the Board of Commissioners, the District's founding government. The "City of Washington" is given a mayor-council form of government.

t: 5月3日的宪法(欧洲第一部现代宪法)由波兰-立陶宛联邦的塞姆宣布.
te: The Constitution of May 3 (the first modern constitution in Europe) is proclaimed by the Sejm of Polish–Lithuanian Comm…
dz: 5月3日的宪法(欧洲第一部现代宪法)由波兰-立陶宛联邦的塞姆宣布.
de: The Constitution of May 3 (the first modern constitution in Europe) is proclaimed by the Sejm of Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.

t: 如埃德蒙德·哈莱所预测的,整个北欧和亚洲北部都可以看到日全食,精确时间在4分钟以内.
te: A total solar eclipse is visible across northern Europe and northern Asia, as predicted by Edmond Halley to within four…
dz: 如埃德蒙德·哈莱所预测的,整个北欧和亚洲北部都可以看到日全食,精确时间在4分钟以内.
de: A total solar eclipse is visible across northern Europe and northern Asia, as predicted by Edmond Halley to within four minutes accuracy.

t: 卢敦条约结束了一场法国内战.
te: Treaty of Loudun ends a French civil war.
dz: 卢敦条约结束了一场法国内战.
de: Treaty of Loudun ends a French civil war.

t: 受西班牙军队对卡罗琳堡的野蛮攻击而愤怒,一支法国部队烧毁了圣马特奥要塞并屠杀了数百名西班牙人.
te: Angered by the brutal onslaught of Spanish troops at Fort Caroline, a French force burns the San Mateo fort and massacr…
dz: 受西班牙军队对卡罗琳堡的野蛮攻击而愤怒,一支法国部队烧毁了圣马特奥要塞并屠杀了数百名西班牙人.
de: Angered by the brutal onslaught of Spanish troops at Fort Caroline, a French force burns the San Mateo fort and massacres hundreds of Spaniards.

t: 孔戈君主恩克武·恩辛格受葡萄牙传教士的洗礼,采用若昂一世的洗礼名.
te: Kongo monarch Nkuwu Nzinga is baptised by Portuguese missionaries, adopting the baptismal name of João I.
dz: 孔戈君主恩克武·恩辛格受葡萄牙传教士的洗礼,采用若昂一世的洗礼名.
de: Kongo monarch Nkuwu Nzinga is baptised by Portuguese missionaries, adopting the baptismal name of João I.

t: 三场地震中最大的一场发生在罗德岛，估计造成 30,000 人伤亡。
te: The largest of three earthquakes strikes the island of Rhodes and causes an estimated 30,000 casualties.
dz: 三场地震中最大的一场发生在罗德岛，估计造成 30,000 人伤亡。
de: The largest of three earthquakes strikes the island of Rhodes and causes an estimated 30,000 casualties.

t: 德国国王奥托三世在教宗约翰十五世去世后,选择卡林西亚的堂兄布鲁诺为教皇. 布鲁诺以格里高利五世…
te: German king Otto III chooses his cousin Bruno of Carinthia as pope following the death of Pope John XV. Bruno becomes p…
dz: 德国国王奥托三世在教宗约翰十五世去世后,选择卡林西亚的堂兄布鲁诺为教皇. 布鲁诺以格里高利五世的名字成为教皇.
de: German king Otto III chooses his cousin Bruno of Carinthia as pope following the death of Pope John XV. Bruno becomes pope under the name Gregory V.

t: 现代墨西哥恰帕斯州雅克西兰的玛雅王鸟捷豹四世登上王位.
te: Mayan king Bird Jaguar IV of Yaxchilan in modern-day Chiapas, Mexico, assumes the throne.
dz: 现代墨西哥恰帕斯州雅克西兰的玛雅王鸟捷豹四世登上王位.
de: Mayan king Bird Jaguar IV of Yaxchilan in modern-day Chiapas, Mexico, assumes the throne.
